name: Urushi Nuri
description: Urushi Nuri — a WooCommerce store theme for a small urushi lacquerware workshop, laid out like an app with a side rail. A white top header carries the workshop name, the account, the cart and a Shop the lacquerware button; on wide screens the main menu runs down a fixed seiheki side rail under it (numbered; a vertical line in Chinese and Japanese), and below 1100 px it opens as a seiheki panel. Seiheki blue-green (#478384) is the main colour: the hero, the side rail, the drying-room band, every page head and the footer strip are seiheki fields; the pages sit on pale celadon with white app panels. The hero is a scene map: an isometric drawing of the workshop with five numbered pins and a legend; a cut-out vermilion bowl (transparent WebP) breaks out of the map frame and a cut-out jubako breaks over the hero's bottom edge and out of the drying-cabinet frame into the band's top edge. Every picture is a 2.5D isometric illustration. Zen Maru Gothic for display, Manrope for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-28 (sidebar-app, scene-map hero, side-rail nav, cutout-break-frame, 2.5d-isometric, seiheki #478384, Zen Maru Gothic + Manrope, urushi lacquerware workshop in crafts-homeware). A formal white top header (workshop name, account, cart, Shop the lacquerware button). Side rail: from 1100 px the main menu runs down a fixed seiheki column under the header (numbered, with the opening hours; a vertical line in Chinese and Japanese); below 1100 px it opens from a menu button as a seiheki panel. Sidebar-app: the pages sit on pale celadon with white app panels and status cards (workshop board, shelf, stages, notes). Scene-map hero: an isometric drawing of the workshop with five numbered pins and a legend. Break-frame: the cut-out vermilion bowl (transparent WebP) breaks out of the framed workshop map at its top-right corner and over the seiheki hero field; the cut-out jubako breaks over the hero's bottom edge into the workshop board, and a second jubako breaks out of the framed drying-cabinet drawing and over the top edge of the seiheki band; the bowl breaks over the bottom edge of every page head. Every picture is a 2.5D isometric raster illustration generated with Grok Build. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: white #FFFFFF on seiheki #478384 4.3:1, used only for large text (hero and page-head titles at 36 px and up, the hero's vertical line, rail menu items and the overlay menu in 20 px bold and larger, board label 24 px, page-head leads and the footer line in 20 px bold); every smaller label on seiheki sits on a pale chip: deep seiheki #24585A on paper #F3F7F6 7.4:1 (eyebrows, rail label, opening hours, breadcrumbs, rail numbers); body text sits on white panels: ink #0F2222 on white 16.5:1 and on mist #DDEBE8 13.5:1; deep seiheki on white 8.0:1 and on mist 6.5:1 (links, prices, labels, buttons: white on deep 8.0:1); slate #475B5B on white 7.2:1 and on mist 5.9:1 (secondary text); shu vermilion #A6382A on white 6.5:1 (small marks; white on shu 6.5:1 cart badge); white on ink 16.5:1 and pale seiheki #BFE0DB on ink 11.7:1 (footer, map legend, rail hours); ink on seiheki only 3.8:1 and paper on seiheki 4.0:1, never used for small text.
